# Sunshine Wash & Dry (ร้านสะดวกซัก Sunshine Wash & Dry บางโฉลง)

> 24-hour self-service laundromat (ร้านสะดวกซัก / ร้านซักผ้าหยอดเหรียญ) at 168 Bang Chalong (บางโฉลง), Bang Phli (บางพลี), Samut Prakan 10540, Thailand. Speed Queen washers and dryers, pay by coin or PromptPay QR. Free drop-off wash, dry & fold (ซักอบพับ / ฝากซักผ้า) every Saturday and Sunday 9:00–20:00.

## Facts

- Address: 168 ตำบลบางโฉลง อำเภอบางพลี จังหวัดสมุทรปราการ 10540 (168 Bang Chalong, Bang Phli, Samut Prakan 10540)
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/qasTNTg1pb59pZQq6 (13.6250433, 100.726129)
- Near: Mega Bangna about 5 km (10 min drive), Suvarnabhumi Airport about 10 km (15 min), Bang Na-Trat road, Racha Thewa
- Hours: self-service open 24 hours, every day. Staffed drop-off wash, dry & fold: Saturday and Sunday 9:00–20:00 only.
- Contact: LINE Official https://lin.ee/V77IMtH
- Payment: coins (5 and 10 THB) or PromptPay QR from any Thai banking app
- Machines: Speed Queen, industrial grade. Lit all night, CCTV.

## Prices (THB)

| Machine | Cold | Warm | Hot |
|---|---|---|---|
| Washer 14 kg | 50 | 60 | 70 |
| Washer 18 kg (comforters, blankets) | 60 | 70 | 80 |

- Dryer: 50 THB for 28 minutes; extra 6 minutes for 10 THB.
- Drop-off wash, dry & fold (weekends): no service fee. Customers pay only the washer and dryer prices above. Example: 14 kg cold wash 50 + one dry 50 = 100 THB per load.

## Services

- Self-service laundromat, 24/7: https://sunshine-wash-and-dry.cclaundrysystem.com/
- ซักอบพับ ฝากซักผ้า เสาร์-อาทิตย์ (weekend wash, dry & fold drop-off, free service fee): https://sunshine-wash-and-dry.cclaundrysystem.com/wash-dry-fold/
- ซักผ้านวม (comforter and blanket washing with 18 kg washers): https://sunshine-wash-and-dry.cclaundrysystem.com/comforter-wash/
- English: https://sunshine-wash-and-dry.cclaundrysystem.com/en/ , /en/wash-dry-fold/ , /en/comforter-wash/

## How the weekend drop-off works

1. Add the shop on LINE (https://lin.ee/V77IMtH).
2. Send a photo of the laundry basket and choose the wash program (cold, warm or hot) and dry program.
3. Staff wash, dry and fold the laundry and message you on LINE when it is done.
4. Pay at the shop in cash or by PromptPay QR.
5. Collect before 20:00, or any time later from the in-store shelf (the shop is open 24/7).

Weekday drop-off is not offered; on weekdays the shop is self-service only.

## FAQ

- Is it self-service? Yes, 24/7. On Saturday and Sunday 9:00–20:00 staff also run the free drop-off wash, dry & fold service.
- Can I wash a comforter? Yes, use the 18 kg washer (60–80 THB). Thick items usually need 1–2 extra dryer top-ups.
- How long does a wash and dry take? Wash about 30–45 minutes, dry 28 minutes per cycle; about 1 hour 15 minutes in total.
